body.message:
If you would like to proceed with monthly payments, please note that the first and last month’s rent must be paid in advance to secure the unit and the agreed rate.

For the payment, you may choose from the following options:

Secure payment link – subject to a 3.1% card processing fee.
Bank transfer.
Cash payment at our office.

To proceed with the booking, we will first share the security deposit payment link to secure the unit for the first month. Once the deposit payment is completed, you can proceed with the first and last month’s rent payment.

After the required payments are completed, we will share the booking confirmation and check-in form for you to complete the check-in procedure.

Our standard check-in time is 3:00 PM. The remaining check-in details, including access information, will be shared on the check-in date between 2:00 PM and 3:00 PM, once the unit is ready.
